classification.notes: Article is an FCA blog post about post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration guidance for UK financial firms. While it touches on cyber resilience, it describes a long-horizon regulatory guidance/preparation exercise (milestones in 2028, 2031, 2035), not a concrete cyberattack, major outage, or participant system disruption event that maps to XE-CYBER or any other card in the catalog. No DTCC process is directly touched by this forward-looking PQC advisory.
